trello.name: Evaluate PgBouncer for database connection pooling
trello.desc: Raj is to set up a load test that mirrors the dashboard's query pattern and benchmark PgBouncer in transaction mode against the current Postgres setup. He will measure p95 latency with and without PgBouncer under the dashboard workload and bring the performance numbers to the next product sync meeting.

trello.desc: Tom will correct the typo 'recieve' to 'receive' in the onboarding email subject line by updating the email template repository. He will then get the corrected email re-approved by marketing. This is a quick fix to be done today.

trello.name: Update roadmap document to reflect dark mode schedule
trello.desc: Tom will update the roadmap document to remove dark mode from 'Q3 committed' and instead list it under the September design-system upgrade line. This update is to prevent sales from promising dark mode as a standalone feature prematurely. Tom will complete this update immediately after fixing the email typo.
